subject: Asterion service surge — reconciliation package request
messages:
From: Michelle Tang <michelle.tang@asterion.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@asterion.ai, sourabh.kapoor@asterion.ai
Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Service incident during peak — immediate reconciliation request

Hi Soojin,

We saw a significant service surge during our peak window this morning (10:30–11:15 PDT) — generation latency spiked and a subset of requests returned 504s. This disrupted two of our customer demos and one production pipeline. We ran basic checks on our side and don't see anything abnormal from the client side.

Can Redwood confirm root cause and proposed remediation? Separately, we need a reconciliation package: credits to cover affected tokens and a 30-day trial extension for the users impacted. This is time-sensitive since we have an executive review on Monday.

I attached a short uptime_log_summary.csv from our end and have ops on the cc. Please advise next steps.

Thanks,
Michelle
Michelle Tang
Head of ML — Asterion Analytics

Attachments: uptime_log_summary.csv

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Michelle Tang <michelle.tang@asterion.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2026 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service incident during peak — immediate reconciliation request

Hi Michelle — thank you for the heads-up and for sending the summary. I'm really sorry Asterion hit this during demos — I know how disruptive that is. We've escalated to Ops and are pulling the service-side logs right now.

Immediate actions:
- Ops is correlating request IDs and KV cache health (assigned OPS-4821).
- I'll propose a reconciliation package by EOD Pacific: credits for impacted tokens + a 30-day trial window for the affected users.
- If you can share any request IDs or timestamps beyond the CSV, that will help diagnostics.

Next steps from our side:
1) Ops will confirm root cause and a mitigation plan (we'll share incident_timeline.pdf once compiled).
2) I will draft a reconciliation proposal and loop in Marissa and Jonas for approval.
3) If you want a brief postmortem call, I can schedule one early next week.

Can I confirm the number of seats/users you'd like extended if we grant the 30-day trial?

Apologies again — we'll make this right.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Asterion service surge — proposed reconciliation approach (internal)

Folks — looping in the pricing playbook and finance touchpoints. Proposed approach (based on severity and demo impact):

- Immediate: 200k free token credits applied to the Asterion account to cover affected runs.
- Trial extension: 30 days for up to 8 seats (their enterprise POC group).
- Promotional: 25% off Dedicated capacity for first month if they upgrade in next 45 days (helps avoid recurrence during peak).

I've attached a quick proposed_reconciliation_table.xlsx that maps credits to affected time windows and an estimated $ impact. If Ops confirms a service-side regression, I'd like to auto-approve the credits and have Finance apply them — we can gap those against the DEAL-4729 pipeline.

Jonas — do you confirm escalation approval?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RE: Asterion service surge — proposed reconciliation approach (internal)

Approved.

Agreed to the credits (200k tokens), 30-day extension for 8 seats, and the 25% first-month Dedicated discount as a make-good. Marissa — please proceed to coordinate with Finance and get the DocuSign amendment queued for the promotional discount. Include a short note that this is a service-recovery gesture tied to OPS-4821.

Soojin — confirm copy back to Michelle once Finance applies the credits. Also add a short postmortem link when Ops publishes the timeline.

Jonas
VP, Sales

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Michelle Tang <michelle.tang@asterion.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, ops@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service incident during peak — reconciliation package (proposal)

Hi Michelle — thanks again for your patience. Per internal approvals, here is our reconciliation package for Asterion: 

- 200,000 token credits applied immediately to your account (to offset the affected runs).
- 30-day trial window extension for up to 8 seats in your POC group.
- 25% discount on the first month of Dedicated capacity if you choose to reserve within 45 days.

We have Ops compiling a short incident_timeline.pdf (will include root cause and steps taken); I'll send that link as soon as it's available. I've also opened OPS-4821 in our tracker.

If this package works, I'll ask Finance to apply the credits and initiate a DocuSign amendment for the promo discount. Please confirm the 8 seats so we can apply the extension.

Apologies again for the disruption — we want to ensure your demos and pipelines are protected.

Best,
Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Michelle Tang <michelle.tang@asterion.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@asterion.ai, sourabh.kapoor@asterion.ai
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service incident during peak — reconciliation package (proposal)

Thanks, Soojin — that package looks fair and helps a lot. Confirming 8 seats for the trial extension. Please go ahead and have Finance apply the credits; we'll expect the DocuSign amendment and the Ops postmortem early next week.

Appreciate the rapid response.

Michelle
Head of ML — Asterion Analytics
